text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, Trainer. I failed to take the
crown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How humiliating for me to fall at the
first hurdle.
What use is an Emperor who
cannot meet her
subjects' expectations?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am naive. Lacking. Pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's eyes cloud with bitter
regret...
but beneath it, a fire still burns.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But that does not mean my dream is
dead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Two crowns remain. I will vindicate
myself by
claiming the next: the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Our campaign is not yet over. Are you
with me,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's it,
then. We're sticking to the plan
and
aiming for the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we settle down to refocus ourselves
on taking
the two remaining crowns...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come in.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good afternoon, President.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Gene...
text_block_list.text: Sorry to bother you...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, you two. Right on time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for making you watch such a
poor
performance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You must be disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Gene...
text_block_list.text: Not at all!

text_block_list.name: Student Council Gene...
text_block_list.text:
You ran so magnificently, right up to the
finish
line.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Gene...
text_block_list.text:
You were every bit the racer I thought
you were...
Every bit the racer who
inspired me to join the
student council.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your candor. And let me
swear to you
here and now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will become stronger still. Strong
enough for you
to rely on without
hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Gene...
text_block_list.text: ...President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for not seeing your troubles
sooner. A
sign that I must pay closer
attention to those
around me, no doubt.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you want to become stronger, I will
happily
guide you. I don't want you to
suffer in silence.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Gene...
text_block_list.text:
B-but you're so busy! I couldn't
possibly...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's no burden at all. I would be honored
to help
you flourish.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So I ask you to give me one more
chance...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And trust that I am strong enough to
carry you.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Gene...
text_block_list.text:
Why are you being so kind to... to a
waste of
space like me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because you are the purest incarnation
of my
dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have charged myself with building a
world where
all Umamusume can live in
bliss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And you joined the student council in
the hopes
of growing as a person.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will not watch you give in before you
realize
your dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't call yourself a waste of
space. If you
are struggling to find your
way, I will help you
find it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you look up to me as much as you say,
can you
trust me to lead you in the right
direction?

text_block_list.name: Student Council Gene...
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Student Council Gene...
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry I've been acting so scared. I... Sniff... I'll follow you wherever you lead me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't cry. I'm delighted to
see you've
found your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the issue at hand has been
resolved. Rudolf has a knack for leading
through
strength—a tactic befitting an
Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But such strength requires the
determination to carry an enormous
amount of responsibility on her
shoulders. And in that sense, her approach
is...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove watches from a distance, a
hint of
frustration in her eyes.
